The prerequisite for admission to the selection procedure is a Bachelor's degree in the field of architecture with an overall grade equivalent to the German "2.3" or better from a national or international university.
Admission to the Master's degree course of study in Architecture is based on a selection procedure.
The selection procedure consists of a written application, in which students should explain their motivation for study and their study goals.
